snapshot.scope: Time-homogeneous integer stochastic mass action with fixed positive rates; closed communicating classes; physical-time nonexplosion and positive recurrence.

claims.exact_statement: For the network 0->2A, 2A->4A+B, 4A+B->6A+4B, 6A+4B->3A with any fixed positive rate constants and falling-factorial stochastic mass-action propensities, C={(a,b) in N_0^2:a>=3,b>=0} is one closed irreducible class and the minimal CTMC explodes with positive probability from (3,0). Therefore classwise nonexplosion and positive recurrence do not follow from strong endotacticity (hence not from endotacticity).
assumptions: Four reactions exactly as stated; no volume rescaling.
For reaction y->y', propensity is kappa_y,y' times product_i (x_i)_(underline(y_i)), zero when a source is unavailable.
Each of the four rate constants is fixed and strictly positive.
The process is the minimal CTMC up to its explosion time.
claims.status: internally_reconstructed_counterexample; published network/example confirms strong endotacticity and explosion
source_ranges: ACKN arXiv:1808.05328v2, stochastic propensity and strong endotacticity definition, lines 130-155; Example 3.2, lines 199-209.
Xu arXiv:2409.05340, Remark 4.8, lines 319-321, identifies the example as order 10 and notes minimum explosive endotactic order remains open.
claims.novelty_boundary: The explosive network and stochastic mechanism are established prior art. This report independently reconstructs a closed irreducible class and exact local channel probabilities. No novelty or priority claim is made.

costs.input: Two species, four reactions, exact complex vectors, four supplied positive rates.
costs.analysis: Symbolic exact factorial formulas; asymptotic constants depend on the fixed rate vector. No runtime or finite encoding of arbitrary real rates is claimed.
costs.experiment: None performed. A physical test would require high-order channel synthesis/calibration, single-count observations, and bandwidth for a return propensity growing as Theta(n^6).
costs.application_scope: Mathematical stochastic reaction model only; no biological model or clinical claim.

claims.falsifier: The mathematical claim is refuted if any displayed path transition is not enabled under the stated falling-factorial convention, the infinite product of prescribed channel probabilities is zero, or the conditional elapsed-time sum diverges. These obligations are proved explicitly in PROOFS.md.
claims.next_gate: Develop a checkable exact-factorial tier criterion that excludes explosion staircases while preserving useful multidimensional higher-order networks; no such criterion is established here.

claims.exact_statement: For a CTMC, if an infinite prescribed reaction path has positive channel probabilities p_k with sum_k(1-p_k)<infinity and the conditional mean holding times along that path have finite sum, then the path has positive probability and is completed in finite physical time.
assumptions: At each visited state the total jump rate is finite and positive.
Holding time to the next jump is independent of which competing channel fires, as for a CTMC with exponential competing clocks.
The desired reaction sequence is enabled at every step.
claims.status: internally_proved elementary excursion lemma; no novelty claim

claims.novelty_boundary: A standard competing-exponential path argument is restated as a reusable sufficient criterion; not claimed as a new theorem in CTMC theory.

costs.input: An explicit path and exact or bounded rates along it.

claims.falsifier: A dependence between the holding time and selected channel invalidates the stated CTMC conditional-independence premise; a zero product or infinite expected total holding time invalidates this sufficient criterion.
claims.next_gate: Compare the criterion against exact source-tier data for other published endotactic examples, without treating a failed search as a universal guarantee.

claims.exact_statement: Established primary-source sufficient positive-recurrence regimes include: (a) weakly reversible single-linkage binary systems with S or 2S a complex for every species; (b) one-dimensional endotactic mass-action systems under Wiuf-Xu H2-H5 on closed positive irreducible classes; (c) first-order endotactic SMARTs under Xu's 2026 preprint convention; and (d) strongly endotactic bases augmented by the high-order pure-species drains and order constraints in ACKN Theorem 7.2.
assumptions: Each theorem has its own definition of order, stochastic mass-action convention, and communicating-class assumptions, which must be retained as stated in its source.
All reaction rate constants are positive and time-homogeneous in the cited theorems.
The first-order universal theorem is an arXiv preprint as of the primary source checked on 2026-10-08.
